title: Title
description: add_title_tool's titles, the look Zenvi desktop renders with HyperFrames: headline (words rise out of a mask over an accent rule), lower_third (name and role on a dark plate behind an accent bar), end_card (full-frame card), bold_box (social text on solid boxes), kicker (small tracked label between rules) and credits (lines fading up, or rolling past six). Placed by add_title_tool; edit with edit_title_tool.

title.description: Main text (bold_box: one box per line).

accent_color.description: Rule, bar and box colour, empty = the style's.

background_color.description: Full-frame background, alpha allowed; empty = none (end_card: near-black).
